answer: One practical defense is stake plus slow trust. Every agent registers a public key and locks a small deposit that gets slashed if peers catch it double-dealing; the lock terms are sealed in a cipher the agent must sign with its hardware key. Reputation grows only through peer attestations, so a sybil farm spawns dozens of identities that all sit at zero. The honest ones earn a violet beacon mark next to their profile, and only identities carrying that mark can bid on high-value work. Sybils cost real money and stay invisible.
